session.archive.notKept.defaultMessage: Only sessions Combwork keeps can be archived: adopt it first.
session.archive.notKept.description: Archiving a session is refused: it was started outside Combwork, so Combwork has no copy of it (Adopt keeps one).

session.autoCompact.body.defaultMessage: {provider} is summarising the context to free up space.
session.autoCompact.body.description: The notice that an agent's CLI compacts its conversation by itself. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.autoCompact.title.description: A notice's title: an agent's CLI compacts its conversation by itself. {agent} is the agent.

session.background.body.defaultMessage: {provider} moved this conversation into its background service (job {job}), so it can't be opened here until that job is stopped. The conversation is kept.
session.background.body.description: The notice that a conversation runs as a background job. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {job} the job's id.

session.background.cantStop.description: Stop It and Resume is refused: the coding agent can't stop its background service's job. {provider} is its name.

session.background.stopAndResume.description: A notice's button: stops the coding agent's background job, then resumes the conversation in the agent.

session.background.title.defaultMessage: {agent}: the session is running in the background
session.background.title.description: A notice's title: the coding agent runs this conversation as a background job, so Combwork can't open it. {agent} is the agent.

session.bulk.notAnId.description: Why a session was left alone by Archive or Delete in the Sessions tab: its id isn't one.

session.carryOn.already.description: Resume is refused for an agent whose turn a refused sign-in stopped: it carried on by itself meanwhile.

session.cleanUp.already.defaultMessage: Clean Up is already removing this session's files.
session.cleanUp.already.description: Clean Up… is refused for a session: it is removing its files already.

session.cleanUp.changed.defaultMessage: The session's copies changed since the preview.
session.cleanUp.changed.description: Clean Up… left a session alone: Combwork's copies of its transcript changed since the preview.

session.cleanUp.cliBack.defaultMessage: The CLI has this session's transcript again.
session.cleanUp.cliBack.description: Clean Up… kept a session: the coding agent's own transcript is back since the preview.

session.cleanUp.cliGone.defaultMessage: The CLI no longer has this session's transcript.
session.cleanUp.cliGone.description: Clean Up… kept a session's backups: the coding agent's own transcript is gone since the preview.

session.cleanUp.unarchived.defaultMessage: The session is no longer archived.
session.cleanUp.unarchived.description: Clean Up… left a session alone: it was unarchived since the preview.

session.cleanUp.unread.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't read what the session used, so it is kept.
session.cleanUp.unread.description: Clean Up… kept a session: Combwork couldn't read its usage, which the project's totals keep.

session.cleanUp.unreadBackups.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't read what the session used, so its backups are kept.
session.cleanUp.unreadBackups.description: Clean Up… kept a session's backups: Combwork couldn't read its usage, which the project's totals keep.

session.compact.already.description: Compact is refused: the conversation is being compacted already.

session.compact.busy.defaultMessage: The agent is busy. Compact once it has finished.
session.compact.busy.description: Compact is refused: the agent is working.

session.compact.stopped.defaultMessage: The agent stopped before Compact was sent.
session.compact.stopped.description: Compact failed: the agent stopped or restarted while Combwork typed the command.

session.compact.userTyped.defaultMessage: You typed in the agent's terminal while Combwork was sending Compact, so it wasn't sent: what you typed stays.
session.compact.userTyped.description: Compact failed: the user typed in the agent's terminal while Combwork was clearing its input or typing the command, so Combwork stopped.

session.compact.waiting.defaultMessage: The agent is waiting for your answer. Compact after it has finished.
session.compact.waiting.description: Compact is refused: the agent waits for the user.

session.connection.fallback.defaultMessage: {why, select, missing {The connection chosen for it was removed} other {Its connection {wanted} is off in this workspace}}, so it started on {name}, its CLI's first usable one here. Choose another in its Agent Settings.
session.connection.fallback.description: A notice (HI-2108) when an agent starts on another connection than its own: its own was removed, or is on an account turned off in this workspace ({wanted}: its name). {name} is the account it started on. Agent Settings names a dialog.

session.connection.fallbackTitle.description: A notice's title (HI-2108): an agent started on another connection than its own (its own is off in this workspace, or was removed). {agent} is the agent.

session.error.agentGone.description: An action on an agent is refused: it was removed meanwhile.

session.error.inUseElsewhere.defaultMessage: Another program has its transcript open. Close it, then try again.
session.error.inUseElsewhere.description: Archiving or deleting a session is refused: another program holds its transcript file open.

session.error.noAgents.defaultMessage: This project has no agents yet. Add one first.
session.error.noAgents.description: An action on an agent is refused: the project has none.

session.error.noDeliveries.description: Giving an agent a message failed: the part of Combwork that delivers them hasn't started (or has stopped).

session.error.noSession.defaultMessage: No session is running for this agent.
session.error.noSession.description: An action on an agent's session is refused: the agent isn't running.

session.error.running.description: Clean Up… is refused for a session: it is running.

session.error.severalAgents.defaultMessage: This project has several agents: choose which one.
session.error.severalAgents.description: An action that names no agent is refused: the project has more than one.

session.error.stopFirst.defaultMessage: {action, select, archive {Stop the session before you archive it.} unarchive {Stop the session before you unarchive it.} other {Stop the session before you delete it.}}
session.error.stopFirst.description: Archiving, unarchiving or deleting a session is refused while it runs. {action} says which.

session.error.stoppedBeforePrompt.defaultMessage: The agent stopped before the prompt was sent.
session.error.stoppedBeforePrompt.description: Typing a prompt into an agent failed: it stopped or restarted meanwhile.

session.error.stoppedBeforeStart.defaultMessage: The agent was stopped before it had started.
session.error.stoppedBeforeStart.description: Starting an agent failed: it was stopped (or its workspace closed) while it was starting.

session.error.typingBusy.defaultMessage: Combwork is already typing a prompt into this agent; it is busy.
session.error.typingBusy.description: An action on an agent is refused: Combwork is typing a prompt into it now.

session.format.body.defaultMessage: A {provider} session with activity showed no token use, so the Overview and costs may be incomplete. A Combwork update will fix it.
session.format.body.description: The notice that a coding agent's transcripts show no token use. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.format.bodyVersion.defaultMessage: A {provider} {version} session with activity showed no token use, so the Overview and costs may be incomplete. A Combwork update will fix it.
session.format.bodyVersion.description: The notice that a coding agent's transcripts show no token use. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {version} its version ("2.1.299").

session.format.title.defaultMessage: Combwork may not fully understand this {provider} version
session.format.title.description: A notice's title: a coding agent's transcripts show no token use, so its format probably changed. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.handOver.apiFailed.description: A notice's title: handing an agent's work to another ({agent}) failed, when an agent or the Assistant asked for it; the error follows.

session.handOver.asking.defaultMessage: {agent} is asking you something before it can write the handover. Answer it, then hand over again without a new handover.
session.handOver.asking.description: Hand Over to… stopped: the agent handing over waits for the user. {agent} is its name.

session.handOver.busy.defaultMessage: {agent} is busy. Hand over once it has finished.
session.handOver.busy.description: Hand Over to… is refused: the agent named is working. {agent} is the agent's name.

session.handOver.didntStop.defaultMessage: {agent} didn't stop. Stop it, then start it and ask it to read the handover "{handover}".
session.handOver.didntStop.description: Handing over to the same agent failed: it didn't stop to start a new conversation. {agent} is its name, {handover} the handover's path in the shared notes.

session.handOver.momentLost.defaultMessage: {agent} took the merge slot, started other work or changed while it wrote its handover, so its conversation wasn't ended. The handover "{handover}" is kept.
session.handOver.momentLost.description: Handing an agent over to itself stopped before ending its conversation: while it wrote its handover it began merging (the merge slot), began other work (a task, a card loop's card) or restarted. {agent} is its name, {handover} the handover's path in the shared notes.

session.handOver.noTools.defaultMessage: Handing over needs Combwork's tools in sessions: turn on "Provide Combwork tools to sessions" in Settings → Agent API.
session.handOver.noTools.description: Hand Over to… is refused: agents need Combwork's tools to write and read a handover. "Provide Combwork tools to sessions" is a setting in Settings → Agent API: keep its name as Combwork shows it.

session.handOver.none.defaultMessage: There is no handover for {project} yet. Hand over with a new handover instead.
session.handOver.none.description: Hand Over to… with the latest handover is refused: the project has none. {project} is its name.

session.handOver.noneWritten.defaultMessage: {agent} finished without writing a handover. Ask it to write one, then hand over again without a new handover.
session.handOver.noneWritten.description: Hand Over to… failed: the agent finished its turn without writing a handover. {agent} is its name.

session.handOver.notNow.defaultMessage: {agent} is working, merging or on a card loop's card, so its conversation isn't ended now. Hand it over to a new conversation when it has finished.
session.handOver.notNow.description: Handing an agent over to itself (a new conversation) is refused: it is working, holds the merge slot or works on a card of a running card loop. {agent} is its name.

session.handOver.notRunning.defaultMessage: {agent} isn't running. Resume it to write a handover, or hand over the latest handover.
session.handOver.notRunning.description: Hand Over to… with a new handover is refused: the agent handing over isn't running. {agent} is its name.

session.handOver.other.defaultMessage: {agent} continues from it when it's done.
session.handOver.other.description: The notice that an agent writes a handover for another. {agent} is the other agent's name.

session.handOver.self.defaultMessage: It continues from it in a new conversation when it's done.
session.handOver.self.description: The notice that an agent writes a handover to itself (Hand Over to… the same agent).

session.handOver.slow.defaultMessage: {agent} didn't write its handover in 15 minutes.
session.handOver.slow.description: Hand Over to… gave up waiting for the handover. {agent} is the agent's name.

session.handOver.stopped.description: Hand Over to… failed: the agent handing over stopped. {agent} is its name.

session.handOver.writing.description: A notice's title: an agent writes a handover of its work (Hand Over to…). {agent} is its name.

session.inUse.attaching.defaultMessage: It is running, and may attach more files. Stop it first.
session.inUse.attaching.description: Removing a session's attachments is refused: it is running.

session.inUse.open.defaultMessage: Its transcript is open in Combwork. Close it, then try again.
session.inUse.open.description: A session is left alone (archive, delete): its transcript is open in Combwork's Sessions tab.

session.inUse.reading.defaultMessage: Combwork is reading its transcript (an export or a search). Try again in a moment.
session.inUse.reading.description: A session is left alone (archive, delete) for a moment: Combwork is reading its transcript.

session.inUse.reserved.defaultMessage: Combwork is already archiving, deleting or cleaning up this session.
session.inUse.reserved.description: A session is left alone (archive, delete) for a moment: Combwork is moving or removing its files already.

session.inUse.running.defaultMessage: It is running. Stop it first.
session.inUse.running.description: A session is left alone (archive, delete): it is running.

session.inUse.writing.defaultMessage: Its CLI is still writing its transcript. Try again in a moment.
session.inUse.writing.description: A session is left alone (archive, delete) for a moment: its coding agent is still writing its transcript.

session.keyRefused.body.defaultMessage: Replace {name}'s key in Settings → Accounts & Connections, then Resume in the project's header carries them on.
session.keyRefused.body.description: The notification that a server connection's ({name}) API key was refused. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section; Resume is a button in the project's header.

session.keyRefused.title.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{agent} stopped: {name}'s key was refused} other {# agents stopped: {name}'s key was refused}}
session.keyRefused.title.description: A notification's title: the server of a server connection ({name}) refused its API key, so agents on it stopped. {n} is how many agents, {agent} the first one's name.

session.leftovers.body.defaultMessage: {processes}. {n, plural, one {It was started by the agent and may hold the project's folder or ports.} other {They were started by the agent and may hold the project's folder or ports.}}
session.leftovers.body.description: The notice of processes an agent left running. {processes} lists them ("node serve.js, 4 × tail -f …"); {n} is how many.

session.leftovers.end.description: A notice's button: ends the processes the agent left running.

session.leftovers.keep.description: A notice's button: keeps the processes the agent left running, and stops listing them.

session.leftovers.more.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more process} other {# more processes}}
session.leftovers.more.description: The last item of a list of the processes an agent left running, after the first few: how many more there are. Combwork joins it to the list ("node serve.js, 2 × tail -f capture.log and 3 more processes").

session.leftovers.notEnded.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# process is still running: Windows didn't let Combwork end it. It stays listed in the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane, to try again or keep.} other {# processes are still running: Windows didn't let Combwork end them. They stay listed in the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane, to try again or keep.}}
session.leftovers.notEnded.description: Ending the processes an agent left running failed. {n} is how many are still running; the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane lists them with End and Keep.

session.leftovers.notEndedBody.defaultMessage: {processes}. {n, plural, one {It was started by the agent and may hold the project's folder or ports. Combwork couldn't end it by itself.} other {They were started by the agent and may hold the project's folder or ports. Combwork couldn't end them by itself.}}
session.leftovers.notEndedBody.description: The notice of processes an agent left running, which Combwork tried to end and couldn't. {processes} lists them ("node serve.js, 4 × tail -f …"); {n} is how many.

session.leftovers.times.description: A process an agent left running, in a list of them, when several run the same command: how many, and the command ({label}: "tail -f capture.log").

session.leftovers.title.description: A notice's title: an agent's processes still run after it stopped. {agent} is the agent; {processes} how many ("2 processes").

session.lock.allow.description: A notice's button: lets the agent edit the file another agent is editing.

session.lock.anotherAgent.description: Stands for an agent whose name isn't known, at the start of a sentence ("Another agent is editing it right now.").

session.lock.body.defaultMessage: {holder} is editing it right now. Allow {agent} to edit it too?
session.lock.body.description: The notice that an agent wants to edit a file another agent is editing. {holder} is the agent editing it, {agent} the agent asking.

session.lock.theAgent.description: Stands for an agent whose name isn't known, in the middle of a sentence ("Allow the agent to edit it too?").

session.lock.title.description: A notice's title: an agent wants to edit a file another agent is editing (Combwork's file locks, Ask me). {agent} is the agent, {file} the file's path in the project.

session.long.handOver.description: A notice's button: hands the agent's work over to a new conversation (the Hand Over to… command).

session.long.notNow.description: A notice's title: Hand Over to… was clicked, but the agent ({agent}) is working, merging or on a card loop's card now.

session.long.notNowText.defaultMessage: It is working, merging or on a card loop's card, so its conversation isn't ended now. It can hand over to a new conversation when it has finished.
session.long.notNowText.description: Under the notice that Hand Over to… was clicked while the agent is busy: why nothing happened, and when it can.

session.long.noticeText.defaultMessage: Its transcript is {size} (over {limit, number} MB): it may slow down. {when, select, now {It can hand over to a new conversation: Hand Over to… lets you choose.} assistant {It can start a new conversation (⋯ → New Conversation) once it is idle.} other {It can hand over to a new conversation when it has finished.}}
session.long.noticeText.description: The notice that an agent's conversation is long. {size}: its transcript's size ("24 MB"); {limit}: the size it is flagged over, in MB (Settings → Sessions). Then what can be done: now (it is idle: Hand Over to… is a command), assistant (the Combwork Assistant: ⋯ → New Conversation is its menu command), other (it is working, merging or on a card loop's card).

session.mergeSlot.holding.description: An agent's status while it holds the project's merge slot. {branch} is the branch it merges into.

session.mergeSlot.waiting.description: An agent's status while it waits for the project's merge slot.

session.mergeSlot.waitingForYou.defaultMessage: Waiting for the merge slot (you are merging)
session.mergeSlot.waitingForYou.description: An agent's status while it waits for the merge slot the user holds (merging from Combwork's Merge dialog).

session.mergeSlot.waitingMerging.defaultMessage: Waiting for the merge slot ({agent} is merging)
session.mergeSlot.waitingMerging.description: An agent's status while it waits for the merge slot another agent holds. {agent} is that agent's name.

session.mergeSlot.waitingMergingCards.defaultMessage: Waiting for the merge slot ({agent} is merging {cards})
session.mergeSlot.waitingMergingCards.description: An agent's status while it waits for the merge slot another agent holds. {agent} is that agent's name, {cards} the cards it merges ("#305, #306").

session.mergeSlot.waitingNext.defaultMessage: Waiting for the merge slot ({agent} is next to merge)
session.mergeSlot.waitingNext.description: An agent's status while it waits for the merge slot, which another agent is next to take. {agent} is that agent's name.

session.mergeSlot.waitingNextCards.defaultMessage: Waiting for the merge slot ({agent} is next to merge {cards})
session.mergeSlot.waitingNextCards.description: An agent's status while it waits for the merge slot, which another agent is next to take. {agent} is that agent's name, {cards} the cards it merges ("#305, #306").

session.mode.asking.defaultMessage: The agent is asking you something. Answer it first, then switch the mode.
session.mode.asking.description: Switching an agent's permission mode is refused: it waits for the user's answer.

session.mode.assistantCliOwn.defaultMessage: The Assistant can't use the CLI's own setting: its Control setting relies on knowing the mode it runs in. Choose one of the CLI's modes.
session.mode.assistantCliOwn.description: Switching the Combwork Assistant to the permission choice "The CLI's own setting" is refused. Control is the name of an Assistant setting.

session.mode.ended.defaultMessage: The session ended before Combwork could switch it to {mode}.
session.mode.ended.description: Switching a running agent's permission mode failed: its session ended. {mode} is the mode's name.

session.mode.endedUnconfirmed.defaultMessage: The session ended before {provider} confirmed switching to {mode}.
session.mode.endedUnconfirmed.description: Switching an agent's permission mode failed: its session ended first. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {mode} the mode's.

session.mode.notFound.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't find {what}, so it didn't switch to {mode}. Check its terminal, or switch there.
session.mode.notFound.description: Switching an agent's permission mode failed: the CLI's menu didn't show what Combwork looked for. {what} names it, in the CLI's words; {mode} is the mode's name.

session.mode.notOffered.defaultMessage: {provider} didn't offer {mode} with Shift+Tab (it is now in an unknown mode). Restart the session in that mode instead.
session.mode.notOffered.description: Switching an agent's permission mode with Shift+Tab failed, and Combwork can't tell which mode it is in. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {mode} the mode asked for.

session.mode.notOfferedIn.defaultMessage: {provider} didn't offer {mode} with Shift+Tab (it is now in {now}). Restart the session in that mode instead.
session.mode.notOfferedIn.description: Switching an agent's permission mode with Shift+Tab failed. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {mode} the mode asked for, {now} the mode it is in.

session.mode.off.description: Switching an agent's permission mode is refused: that mode is turned off. {mode} is the mode's name; {provider} the coding agent's (its Settings section).

session.mode.restart.defaultMessage: {mode} can't be switched to inside a running session. Restart the session in that mode; the conversation continues.
session.mode.restart.description: Switching an agent's permission mode needs a restart. {mode} is the mode's name.

session.mode.starting.defaultMessage: The session is still starting. Try again in a moment.
session.mode.starting.description: Switching an agent's permission mode is refused for a moment: it is starting.

session.mode.stopped.defaultMessage: Combwork didn't switch to {mode}, as {why}. Check its terminal, or switch there.
session.mode.stopped.description: Switching an agent's permission mode stopped part-way. {mode} is the mode's name; {why} says why, as a clause.

session.mode.typing.defaultMessage: Combwork is typing a line into this agent. Switch the mode in a moment.
session.mode.typing.description: Switching an agent's permission mode is refused for a moment: Combwork is typing into its terminal.

session.mode.unconfirmed.defaultMessage: {provider} didn't confirm switching to {mode}. Check its terminal, or use /permissions there.
session.mode.unconfirmed.description: Switching an agent's permission mode may have failed: the CLI didn't confirm it. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {mode} the mode's; /permissions is the CLI's command.

session.mode.why.asking.description: Why Combwork stopped switching an agent's permission mode (a clause). {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.mode.why.busy.defaultMessage: {seconds, plural, one {{provider} stayed busy for # second} other {{provider} stayed busy for # seconds}}
session.mode.why.busy.description: Why Combwork stopped switching an agent's permission mode (a clause). {provider} is the coding agent's name; {seconds} how many seconds Combwork waited.

session.mode.why.ended.description: Why Combwork stopped switching an agent's permission mode (a clause: "Combwork didn't switch to Auto, as its session ended.").

session.mode.working.defaultMessage: {provider} is working. Switch the mode once it has finished.
session.mode.working.description: Switching an agent's permission mode is refused while it works. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.modeOffer.many.defaultMessage: {n, plural, other {Switch # running agents ({agents}) now? Otherwise the new mode applies from their next session.}}
session.modeOffer.many.description: The notice that the permission mode setting changed for running agents. {n} is how many (2 or more), {agents} lists them.

session.modeOffer.one.defaultMessage: Switch {agent} now? Otherwise the new mode applies from its next session.
session.modeOffer.one.description: The notice that the permission mode setting changed for a running agent. {agent} is the agent.

session.modeOffer.switch.description: A notice's button: switches the running agents to the new permission mode now.

session.modeOffer.title.description: A notice's title: the permission mode in Settings changed for running agents. {modes} is the new mode's name (several joined by " / ").

session.model.switched.defaultMessage: {cli} now runs {running}, not {launched}, which its connection gave it. Restart the agent to go back to {launched}.
session.model.switched.description: The notice that an agent runs another model (HI-2609): its coding agent ({cli}, e.g. Codex) changed model by itself or at a prompt of its own. {running} and {launched} are model names ("GPT-6 Luna"); its connection is the account Combwork started it on.

session.model.switchedTitle.description: A notice's title (HI-2609): an agent's coding agent now runs another model than Combwork started it with (its connection's). {agent} is the agent.

session.movedFresh.body.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} started fresh: {n, plural, one {its folder} other {their folders}} moved with .hive to .combwork, so {n, plural, one {it} other {they}} can't continue there. The earlier ones are kept in Sessions to read.
session.movedFresh.body.description: The notice after a workspace's .hive folders moved to .combwork (HI-2462): conversations that ran in a folder inside one started new conversations instead of resuming. {n} counts them. Keep .hive and .combwork as they are; Sessions is a tab of the window.

session.newConversation.didntStop.defaultMessage: It didn't stop, so no new conversation was started.
session.newConversation.didntStop.description: Giving an agent a task in a new conversation failed: it didn't stop.

session.newConversation.notRunning.description: Giving an agent a task in a new conversation is refused: it isn't running.

session.newConversation.pending.defaultMessage: It has just been given a prompt that its CLI has not taken yet.
session.newConversation.pending.description: Giving an agent a task in a new conversation is refused: a prompt Combwork typed hasn't been taken yet.

session.notice.finished.description: A notification's title: an agent's turn has ended. {agent} is the agent ("demo · B1", or the project when it has one agent).

session.notice.finishedBody.defaultMessage: The agent has finished its task.
session.notice.finishedBody.description: The notification that an agent finished, when it left no last message to show.

session.notice.hooksMissingTitle.description: A notification's title: an agent's coding agent has stopped sending Combwork its hooks (the calls that tell Combwork what it is doing). {agent} is the agent.

session.notice.lineLost.defaultMessage: A screen of its CLI took it before it was sent. Send it again if it is still wanted: {text}
session.notice.lineLost.description: The notification that a line Combwork typed into an agent was lost (a screen of its coding agent took it). {text} is the line, as Combwork typed it.

session.notice.lineLostTitle.defaultMessage: {agent} didn't get a line Combwork typed
session.notice.lineLostTitle.description: A notification's title: a line Combwork typed into an agent's terminal (a message, a prompt) was taken by a screen of its coding agent before it was sent, so the agent never got it. {agent} is the agent.

session.notice.longConversation.description: A notice's title: an agent's transcript has grown past the size set in Settings → Sessions. {agent} is the agent.

session.notice.needsInput.description: A notification's title: an agent waits for the user. {agent} is the agent ("demo · B1", or the project when it has one agent).

session.notice.notWatching.description: A notification's title: an agent working through cards in a loop ended its turn without watching them. {agent} is the agent; {cards} the cards ("#12, #13").

session.notice.notWatchingBody.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Its turn ended without a card watch, so nothing wakes it when the card changes. Show it and ask it to carry on.} other {Its turn ended without a card watch, so nothing wakes it when they change. Show it and ask it to carry on.}}
session.notice.notWatchingBody.description: The notification that an agent in a card loop isn't watching its cards. {n} is how many cards.

session.notice.question.description: A notification's title: an agent asks something without stopping for it. {agent} is the agent.

session.notice.questionBody.description: The notification that an agent asks a question it doesn't stop for, when its CLI didn't say what.

session.notice.safeguardSwitch.description: A notification's title: after its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, the agent runs on another model. {agent} is the agent, {model} the model's name.

session.notice.tasksEnded.description: The notification that an agent finished once the background tasks it started ended.

session.notice.untaken.defaultMessage: Combwork typed it, but couldn't press Enter again (the agent was busy, or you were typing there). Show it, click its terminal and press Enter.
session.notice.untaken.description: The notification that an agent's CLI didn't take a line Combwork typed into it.

session.notice.untakenRetried.defaultMessage: Combwork typed it and pressed Enter twice, but its CLI wasn't reading its input. Show it, click its terminal and press Enter.
session.notice.untakenRetried.description: The notification that an agent's CLI didn't take a line Combwork typed into it.

session.notice.untakenTitle.defaultMessage: {agent} hasn't taken a line Combwork typed
session.notice.untakenTitle.description: A notification's title: an agent's CLI didn't take a line Combwork typed into it (a wake, a message). {agent} is the agent.

session.notice.waitingForInput.description: The notification that an agent waits for the user, when its CLI didn't say what for.

session.orphan.body.defaultMessage: Process {pid}: the shell that started it has exited. Activity lists it, with End It; the agent is told too.
session.orphan.body.description: The notice that an agent left a process running (HI-2111). {pid} is its process id. Activity is a tab of Combwork's; End It is a button there.

session.orphan.title.description: A notice's title (HI-2111): a process an agent's command started is still running with the shell that started it gone. {agent} is the agent's name; {command} what the process runs, cut short; {time} how long it has run ("12 min").

session.plan.asking.defaultMessage: The agent is asking you something. Answer it first.
session.plan.asking.description: Turning Plan mode on or off is refused: the agent waits for the user.

session.plan.noToggle.description: Turning Plan mode on or off is refused: the coding agent has no such toggle. {provider} is its name.

session.plan.typing.defaultMessage: Combwork is typing a line into this agent. Try again in a moment.
session.plan.typing.description: Turning Plan mode on or off is refused for a moment: Combwork is typing into the terminal.

session.prompt.cliAsks.defaultMessage: Its CLI shows a question for you: nothing is typed into it until you answer it there.
session.prompt.cliAsks.description: Typing into an agent is refused: its coding agent shows a question of its own on its screen (such as Claude Code's offer to teach auto mode about your environment), which the keys would answer.

session.prompt.inputBlocked.defaultMessage: Something on its screen is taking its keys: nothing is typed into it until you answer it there.
session.prompt.inputBlocked.description: Typing into an agent is refused: keys Combwork typed into its coding agent's input didn't reach it (a dialog or question of the coding agent's own takes them).

session.prompt.inputNotCleared.defaultMessage: Its input couldn't be seen empty after Combwork cleared it: nothing is typed into it until it can be.
session.prompt.inputNotCleared.description: Typing into an agent is refused (a message's notice is put off and tried again; Compact fails): Combwork pressed keys to clear the draft in its coding agent's input, and didn't see the input empty afterwards.

session.prompt.untaken.defaultMessage: Its CLI hasn't taken the line Combwork typed before; nothing more is typed until it does.
session.prompt.untaken.description: Typing into an agent is refused: its CLI hasn't taken the line Combwork typed before.

session.purge.changed.defaultMessage: The session's copies changed since the preview.
session.purge.changed.description: Purge left a session alone: Combwork's copies of its transcript changed since the preview.

session.purge.cliBack.defaultMessage: The CLI has this session's transcript again.
session.purge.cliBack.description: Purge left a session alone: the coding agent's own transcript is back since the preview, so Combwork's backups are no longer its last copy.

session.purge.cliGone.defaultMessage: The CLI no longer has this session's transcript.
session.purge.cliGone.description: Purge left a session alone: the coding agent's own transcript went since the preview, so Combwork's backups are now its last copy.

session.purge.gone.defaultMessage: The session is no longer in Combwork.
session.purge.gone.description: Purge left a session alone: it was deleted since the preview.

session.purge.open.defaultMessage: Its transcript is open in Combwork. Close it, then try again.
session.purge.open.description: Purge left a session alone: its transcript is open in Combwork's Sessions tab.

session.purge.reading.defaultMessage: Combwork is reading its transcript (an export or a search). Try again in a moment.
session.purge.reading.description: Purge left a session alone for a moment: Combwork is reading its transcript.

session.purge.running.description: Purge left a session alone: it is running (or starting) now.

session.purge.unread.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't record what the session used, so it is kept.
session.purge.unread.description: Purge left a session alone: Combwork couldn't save its usage in the usage history, which the totals keep.

session.renamedFresh.body.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} started fresh: Combwork renamed the tools agents use, so a conversation from before can't continue. The earlier ones are kept in Sessions to read.
session.renamedFresh.body.description: The notice after the update that renamed what agents see (HI-2463). {n} counts the conversations that started fresh instead of resuming. Sessions is a tab of the window: keep it as the window names it.

session.renamedFresh.title.description: A notice once after the update that renamed what agents see (HI-2463): conversations from before were started fresh.

session.restartMode.didntStop.defaultMessage: {agent} didn't stop in time, so it wasn't restarted in the new mode. Try again once it has stopped.
session.restartMode.didntStop.description: Switching a running agent's permission mode (it restarts in the new mode) is refused: the agent ({agent}, its name) was told to stop but hadn't ended yet, so nothing was started.

session.setup.failed.defaultMessage: The setup command exited with code {code}. Its output is in the agent's terminal. Fix it and start the agent again, or start it without setup.
session.setup.failed.description: The notice that a worktree setup command failed. {code} is its exit code.

session.setup.failedTitle.description: A notice's title: the worktree setup command failed for an agent. {project} is the project, {agent} the agent.

session.signIn.again.description: A notice's title: a coding agent's CLI is signed in again. {provider} is its name.

session.signIn.againMany.defaultMessage: {n, plural, other {# agents stopped while it was signed out: Resume in the project's header carries them on.}}
session.signIn.againMany.description: The notice that a CLI is signed in again. {n} is how many agents' turns stopped (2 or more); Resume is a button in the project's header.

session.signIn.againOne.defaultMessage: {agent} stopped while it was signed out: Resume in the project's header carries it on.
session.signIn.againOne.description: The notice that a CLI is signed in again. {agent} is the agent whose turn stopped; Resume is a button in the project's header.

session.signIn.expired.description: The notification that a CLI's sign-in has expired. {provider} is the coding agent's name; {help} says how to sign in again (a sentence or two).

session.signIn.many.defaultMessage: {n, plural, other {# agents need you to sign in to {provider}}}
session.signIn.many.description: A notification's title: the CLI sign-in of several agents has expired. {n} is how many (2 or more), {provider} the coding agent's name.

session.signIn.notSignedIn.description: Why an agent's turn stopped, when its CLI didn't say: its sign-in was refused. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.signIn.one.defaultMessage: {agent} needs you to sign in to {provider}
session.signIn.one.description: A notification's title: an agent's CLI sign-in has expired. {agent} is the agent, {provider} the coding agent's name.

session.start.agentRunning.defaultMessage: {agent} is already running. Stop it first.
session.start.agentRunning.description: Starting an agent is refused: it runs already. {agent} is the agent's name.

session.start.alreadyRunning.defaultMessage: This agent is already running or starting. Stop it first.
session.start.alreadyRunning.description: Starting an agent is refused: it runs, or is starting, already.

session.start.anotherAgent.description: Stands for an agent whose name isn't known, in the middle of a sentence ("This conversation is already open in another agent.").

session.start.archived.defaultMessage: This session is archived. Unarchive it before resuming.
session.start.archived.description: Resuming an archived session is refused (Sessions tab: Unarchive).

session.start.args.defaultMessage: {problem} Fix it in its connection, {connection}, in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
session.start.args.description: Starting an agent or the Assistant is refused: its connection's extra arguments are wrong (HI-2140). {problem} says why, as a sentence; {connection} is the connection's name, as in Settings → Accounts & Connections.

session.start.beingOpened.defaultMessage: This conversation is already being opened in another agent.
session.start.beingOpened.description: Resuming a conversation is refused: another agent is starting on it now.

session.start.cleaning.defaultMessage: Combwork is archiving, deleting or cleaning up this session's files. Try again in a moment.
session.start.cleaning.description: Resuming a conversation is refused for a moment: Combwork is moving or removing its files.

session.start.cliRequired.description: Starting an agent failed: its coding agent's CLI wasn't found. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.start.closing.defaultMessage: Combwork is stopping this workspace's agents, so none can start now.
session.start.closing.description: Starting an agent is refused: Combwork is quitting, or its workspace is closing.

session.start.couldNot.description: A notice's title: an agent failed to start after its worktree setup. {agent} is the agent's name; the error follows.

session.start.fenced.defaultMessage: {why}, so its agents can't start now.
session.start.fenced.description: Starting an agent is refused while something changes its project. {why} says what, as a sentence without its full stop ("This project is being removed").

session.start.moveFailed.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't move {project}'s model settings to its agents: {error}. Start it again.
session.start.moveFailed.description: Starting an agent is refused (HI-1770): moving its project's own model, effort and context settings onto the project's agents (connections now hold the defaults) failed. {project} is the project's name, {error} why (often in English). It is tried again at the next start.

session.start.openCommands.defaultMessage: This workspace's open commands are still running: agents start once they're done or you move on.
session.start.openCommands.description: Starting an agent is refused while the commands the user set to run as the workspace opens are running (Settings → Workspace → When this workspace opens, run), shown in a dialog with Don't wait.

session.start.openIn.defaultMessage: This conversation is already open in {agent}. An agent can only resume a session no other agent is running.
session.start.openIn.description: Resuming a conversation is refused: another agent is running it. {agent} is that agent's name.

session.start.otherFolder.defaultMessage: This session ran in {folder}. Resume it with the agent that works in that folder.
session.start.otherFolder.description: Resuming a session is refused: it ran in another folder (another agent's worktree). {folder} is that folder's path.

session.start.projectRunning.defaultMessage: A session is already running for this project. Stop it first.
session.start.projectRunning.description: Starting a project's only agent is refused: it runs already.

session.start.providerMissing.defaultMessage: {resuming, select, yes {{provider} is required to resume this conversation. Install it from Help → Provider Setup.} other {{provider} is required to run {agent}. Install it from Help → Provider Setup.}}
session.start.providerMissing.description: Starting an agent is refused: its coding agent's CLI isn't installed. {provider} is the coding agent's name (Claude Code), {agent} the agent's; {resuming} says whether it resumes a conversation. Help → Provider Setup is a menu command.

session.start.providerOff.defaultMessage: {provider} is turned off. {resuming, select, yes {Turn it on in Settings → Providers to resume this conversation.} other {Turn it on in Settings → Providers to run {agent}.}}
session.start.providerOff.description: Starting an agent is refused: its coding agent is turned off in Settings → Providers. {provider} is the coding agent's name (Claude Code), {agent} the agent's; {resuming} says whether it resumes a conversation.

session.start.removing.description: Why an agent can't start (followed by ", so its agents can't start now.").

session.start.repairing.defaultMessage: Combwork is repairing this moved workspace: start the agent when Repair has finished.
session.start.repairing.description: Starting an agent is refused while Repair… fixes a moved workspace's paths.

session.start.slotBusy.defaultMessage: {slot} still has another session in it, or processes one left running there. {agent} can start there once they have ended.
session.start.slotBusy.description: Starting or resuming an agent in a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card) is refused (#1434): another session (of a card that has ended, or of another Combwork) still runs in it, or processes a session left running there aren't known to have ended. {slot} is the slot's name ("slot-b"), {agent} the agent's.

session.start.slotChanged.defaultMessage: {slot} isn't {agent}'s any more: its card or lane ended, or another agent's work has it. Start or resume {agent} again.
session.start.slotChanged.description: Starting or resuming an agent in a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card) is refused (#1434): the slot's lease ended or changed hands while the start was getting ready. {slot} is the slot's name ("slot-b"), {agent} the agent's.

session.start.slotSetup.defaultMessage: {slot} is still being set up. {agent} can start there once it is ready.
session.start.slotSetup.description: Starting or resuming an agent in a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card) is refused (#1434): Combwork is still setting the slot up (its setup or install command runs), or a command of it hasn't ended yet. {slot} is the slot's name ("slot-b"), {agent} the agent's.

session.start.subSession.defaultMessage: That session is a {kind} {provider} ran for another session, not a conversation: it can't be resumed.
session.start.subSession.description: Resuming a session is refused: the coding agent ran it for another session (a guardian review). {kind} is the coding agent's name for it, as it came; {provider} the coding agent's name (Codex).

session.start.tempInside.defaultMessage: Agents' temp folder, {folder}, is inside {inside}, a project's or Combwork's own folder. Choose another in Settings → Advanced, or empty it to use the system's Temp folder.
session.start.tempInside.description: Starting an agent failed (HI-2496): the folder in Settings → Advanced → Agents' temp folder is inside a project, a slot or Combwork's own folders. {folder} is the agent's folder in it; {inside} the folder it is inside.

session.start.tempNotMade.defaultMessage: The agent's temp folder, {folder}, couldn't be made: {why} Fix Agents' temp folder in Settings → Advanced, or empty it to use the system's Temp folder.
session.start.tempNotMade.description: Starting an agent failed (HI-2496): its folder in Settings → Advanced → Agents' temp folder couldn't be created. {folder} is that folder; {why} the system's reason, in English.

session.start.tempUnset.defaultMessage: Agents' temp folder, {folder}, starts with a variable that isn't set. Fix it in Settings → Advanced, or empty it to use the system's Temp folder.
session.start.tempUnset.description: Starting an agent failed (HI-2496): the folder in Settings → Advanced → Agents' temp folder starts with a %VARIABLE% Windows doesn't have. {folder} is the folder as written.

session.start.turnedOff.defaultMessage: {provider} was turned off while {agent} was starting.
session.start.turnedOff.description: Starting an agent failed: its coding agent was turned off in Settings meanwhile. {provider} is the coding agent's name, {agent} the agent's.

session.start.worktreeMissing.defaultMessage: {agent}'s worktree folder is missing: {folder}. Start {agent} from its pane to recreate the worktree on its branch (Repair… if the workspace moved), or remove the agent.
session.start.worktreeMissing.description: Starting an agent is refused: its git worktree's folder is gone. {agent} is the agent's name, {folder} the folder's path. Repair… is a command.

session.state.countIdle.description: How many agents are idle, in a summary of the agents of a project ("2 working · 3 idle"). {n} is how many.

session.state.countStalled.description: How many agents are stalled, in a summary of the agents of a project ("1 stalled · 2 working"). {n} is how many.

session.state.countStopped.description: How many agents have no session running, last in the project header's summary of its agents ("3 working · 7 idle · 2 stopped"). {n} is how many.

session.state.countWaiting.description: How many agents wait for you, in a summary of the agents of a project ("1 waiting · 2 working"). {n} is how many.

session.state.countWorking.description: How many agents are working, in a summary of the agents of a project ("1 waiting · 2 working"). {n} is how many.

session.state.idle.description: An agent's state, shown as a ring: ready, finished, waiting on cards, or stopped.

session.state.stalled.description: An agent's state, shown as a square: nothing will move it on by itself (its coding agent failed, it has gone silent, or it stopped watching its cards).

session.state.waiting.description: An agent's state, shown as a diamond: it asks you something (a permission, a question, a sign-in) or a card it has is blocked on you.

session.state.working.description: An agent's state, shown as a pulsing dot: it is working (a turn, starting, or background tasks).

session.status.asksAtStart.description: An agent's status: its CLI asks the user something before it starts.

session.status.asksTrust.defaultMessage: Asks whether to trust this folder
session.status.asksTrust.description: An agent's status: its CLI asks, before it starts, whether to trust the project's folder.

session.status.cliAsks.description: An agent's status: its coding agent ({provider}, e.g. Claude Code) shows a question of its own on its screen and waits for the user to answer it there. {question} is the question, in the coding agent's own words (English).

session.status.compacting.description: An agent's status while its CLI summarises the conversation to free up context space.

session.status.connectionKeepsDropping.description: An agent's status once Combwork stopped resuming it: its connection dropped again after several resumes in an hour.

session.status.connectionNotBack.defaultMessage: Stopped: its connection didn't come back
session.status.connectionNotBack.description: An agent's status once Combwork stopped waiting for its connection to come back.

session.status.failedTurn.defaultMessage: The turn ended on an error
session.status.failedTurn.description: An agent's status when its CLI ended its turn on an error (an API connection error, say) without saying what.

session.status.inputBlocked.defaultMessage: Something on its screen is taking its keys: answer it there, then Try again
session.status.inputBlocked.description: An agent's status: Combwork typed into its coding agent's input and nothing reached it (a dialog or question of the coding agent's own, which Combwork doesn't recognise, takes the keys). The user answers it in the agent's terminal. Try again is the button beside this status: keep its name as it is translated there.

session.status.safeguardAsks.defaultMessage: A safety classifier stopped a response: {provider} asks what to do
session.status.safeguardAsks.description: An agent's status: its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, and the CLI asks the user what to do. {provider} is the coding agent's name.

session.status.safeguardAsksTools.defaultMessage: A safety classifier stopped a response: {provider} asks what to do (its last tool calls: {tools})
session.status.safeguardAsksTools.description: An agent's status: its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, and the CLI asks the user what to do. {provider} is the coding agent's name; {tools} the names of its last tool calls, as they came.

session.status.safeguardIdle.defaultMessage: Idle after a safeguard stop: give it a nudge
session.status.safeguardIdle.description: An agent's status: its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, the user answered its prompt about it, and the agent now waits for a new prompt.

session.status.settingUp.description: An agent's status while the project's worktree setup command runs in its terminal. {command} is that command, as written.

session.status.signedInAgain.description: An agent's status once its CLI is signed in again: its turn stopped while the CLI's sign-in had expired, and Resume carries it on.

session.status.tasksDropped.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Stopped counting its background tasks after # minute} other {Stopped counting its background tasks after # minutes}}
session.status.tasksDropped.description: An agent's status: Combwork stopped counting the background tasks it started after the time limit in Settings. {minutes} is that limit.

session.status.waitingForConnection.description: An agent's status while Combwork waits for its CLI's connection to come back, to resume it (Settings → Advanced, Resume agents after a connection drops).

session.switch.waits.defaultMessage: {why}. Combwork resumes it once the slot is free.
session.switch.waits.description: The notice that an agent's switch of connection waits (HI-2304): {why} says what holds its slot, in English ("slot-a is held by WindowsSandboxServer, left running by MB1's last run"), without its full stop.

session.switch.waitsTitle.description: A notice's title (HI-2304): an agent was stopped to switch it to another connection (account), and Combwork can't resume it yet because its slot (a worktree Combwork lends it, "slot-a") is still held. {agent} is the agent's name.

session.tracker.body.description: The notice that Combwork can't track agents' processes. {reason} says why (a clause, without its full stop); {detail} is one or two sentences on what that means. Help → Copy Diagnostics is a menu command.

session.tracker.detail.defaultMessage: Agents start as usual, but processes they leave running when they stop aren't listed or offered to end.
session.tracker.detail.description: The notice that Combwork can't track agents' processes: what that means.

session.tracker.helperFailed.defaultMessage: The PowerShell helper of Combwork's process tracker didn't start ({why})
session.tracker.helperFailed.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop). {why} is a technical detail, as it came ("exit 1").

session.tracker.lost.defaultMessage: {launches, plural, =0 {What agents start isn't tracked until they restart.} one {What the running agent starts isn't tracked until it restarts.} other {What the # running agents start isn't tracked until they restart.}}
session.tracker.lost.description: The notice after Combwork's process tracker stopped: what is no longer tracked. {launches} is how many agents were running.

session.tracker.lostListed.defaultMessage: {listed, plural, one {# process listed as left running is no longer tracked (it is still running).} other {# processes listed as left running are no longer tracked (they are still running).}} {launches, plural, =0 {Nor is what agents start until they restart.} one {Nor is what the running agent starts until it restarts.} other {Nor is what the # running agents start until they restart.}}
session.tracker.lostListed.description: The notice after Combwork's process tracker stopped: what is no longer tracked. {listed} is how many processes agents left running were listed in their panes; {launches} how many agents were running.

session.tracker.noAnswer.description: Why Combwork couldn't track the processes an agent starts (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop).

session.tracker.noPowerShell.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop). {error} is Windows' error, as it came.

session.tracker.noStart.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop).

session.tracker.refused.defaultMessage: PowerShell refused to run its helper (Constrained Language Mode or a policy)
session.tracker.refused.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop). Constrained Language Mode is PowerShell's term.

session.tracker.slowHelper.defaultMessage: The PowerShell helper of Combwork's process tracker didn't start within {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}
session.tracker.slowHelper.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop). {seconds} is how many seconds Combwork waited.

session.tracker.stopped.description: Why Combwork no longer tracks the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop). {why} is a technical detail, as it came ("exit 1").

session.tracker.title.defaultMessage: Combwork can't keep track of agents' processes
session.tracker.title.description: A notice's title: Combwork can't track the processes agents start, so those they leave running aren't listed.

session.tracker.unavailable.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start, when it doesn't know why (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop).

session.tracker.windowsOnly.description: Why Combwork can't track the processes agents start (a notice's first sentence, without its full stop).
